name: Minolta Freedom Action Zoom
note: one camera under three names. Riva Zoom Pico is the international name and rides the Freedom/Riva column pair; 'Autodate Zoom' is a third retail name that belongs to no market column, so it ships as a plain alias. Source: camera-wiki.org/wiki/Minolta_Freedom_Action_Zoom.

name: Olympus SP-550 Ultra Zoom
note: Olympus's own name for this body is SP-550UZ; the record carries the expanded form the Camedia C-series used. The query-side UZ<->Ultra Zoom variant covers the matcher, but the abbreviation is the name a seller types and a buyer searches, so it also belongs in the data.
